text:
emma_finance: FYI invoice 67890 from last renewal shows a weird line: PLATFORM-BURST-ADJ credit applied but customer is asking for more context. Can someone from sales/ops weigh in?

raj_sales: Which customer?

emma_finance: AcmeHealth (private deploy). They received a $6k credit labeled PLATFORM-BURST-ADJ and an overage charge of $7,200 for 'usage overage (burst)'. Net still shows a +$1,200 hit. They've escalated to their procurement team.

marta_revops: I pulled the billing detail. Here's the invoice snippet: 
```
Invoice 67890
- Private license (annual): $120,000
- Platform fee (annual): $30,000
- Support (Standard -> Premium) prorated: $4,500
- Usage overage (migration burst): $7,200
- Credit: PLATFORM-BURST-ADJ: -$6,000
Balance due: $155,700
```

lex_billing: Where did the credit come from? I don't see a corresponding credit memo in NetSuite yet.

raj_sales: We approved a one-time concession during their migration window — sales thread in 172xxxxxx. Reason was large import that tripped autoscale. I thought ops gave them a courtesy credit for the overage.

ops-bot: Alert: Dedicated pool scaling event detected on 2025-10-03 02:15 UTC. Peak capacity 118% for 3h15m due to bulk import job (job-id: import-acme-20251003).

support_agent: Customer reported spike and asked for explanation on 2025-10-04: "We were billed for overage during migration that was triggered by Redwood's onboarding script. Please justify."

marta_revops: Proposal: treat this as migration-induced and grant a full credit on the overage line, then invoice the platform fee as-is. That would mean additional credit of $7,200 (net overage zero) and reverse the PLATFORM-BURST-ADJ memocode to a proper credit memo. Need approvals from finance + sales.

emma_finance: Full credit might set a precedent. Can we do a partial credit instead? Suggest 70% of overage ($5,040) given that some burst was customer-driven. We also need a PO amendment and a short note tying it to migration support.

raj_sales: I can get Acme to sign a short amendment/ack stating the import was part of onboarding and they accept responsibility for some portion. I'll ask for the PO addendum. If they sign, sales ok with 70% credit.

lex_billing: Once we have sales sign-off, finance can issue a credit memo for $5,040 and post to invoice 67890. Need GL code and reason string. Suggested memo description: "Migration overage concession — approved 70% credit per sales amendment."

marta_revops: GL: 4202 (Customer Credits), reason: "Onboarding migration overage concession". I'll attach the ops-bot event and support thread to the ticket.

emma_finance: Approve issuing credit memo $5,040 once sales provides signed amendment and support thread attached. Lex, can you queue the credit?

lex_billing: ✅ will queue. Need final confirmation in this thread before issuing.

raj_sales: I'll ping Acme procurement now. ETA 48h for signed amendment.

support_agent: I'll forward the customer chat and the import job logs to finance once Acme signs.

emma_finance: Thanks. Tagging for record: @marta_revops @lex_billing @raj_sales. Approve on condition of signed PO addendum and attached ops/support logs. :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
